page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance managed via the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU from the Pascal architecture, equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems operate in the lower performance tiers compared to modern cloud hardware. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is positioned in the bottom 10% with a score of 953.38, while the multi-core performance reaches 4755.08, placing it in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only large block speeds of 37.18 GB/sec and write speeds of 25.34 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET performance also align with the bottom 25% of tested instances, reflecting the older architecture of the underlying Intel Broadwell processor.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge serves as a budget-friendly entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads. By utilizing legacy Pascal-generation GPU hardware and older Intel Xeon processors, it offers a lower-cost alternative for tasks requiring hardware acceleration without the premium pricing associated with newer GPU architectures. This makes the instance suitable for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, basic machine learning inference, video transcoding, and development or testing environments that require CUDA support but do not demand high-throughput CPU or memory performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for entry-level parallel processing workloads. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor at 2.5 GHz, paired with 32 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates modest CPU and memory performance, with stress-ng and PassMark scores placing the instance in the lower performance tiers. Consequently, this instance is best suited for cost-sensitive GPU workloads, such as lightweight machine learning inference, video encoding, and development environments requiring CUDA capabilities, rather than high-performance computing or memory-intensive database applications.
